legitimacy_of_supersession: My original binding condition #1 froze f6_verdict.json 'as recorded' to prevent post-hoc relaxation of a VALID measurement. That protection does not cover this case: run-1 contained a disclosed harness defect that violated the frozen timer boundary, the fix was applied SYMMETRICALLY to both trees, run-1 raw and verdict are retained, the defect and correction are documented in the authoritative record, and - decisively - the correction ran AGAINST the campaign's favor (it reduced FINAL's claimed benefit: 123.4x->2.76x binary headline, geomean 5.14x->1.60x). A re-measurement that lowers one's own headline is the opposite of measure-until-favorable.
The causal-correction allowance is hereby declared CONSUMED by this run-2 correction. No further re-measurement of the F6 comparison is admissible for any reason; run 2 is terminal for this campaign.

The original ruling's grounds 1 (gate-scope), 5 (mitigation out of scope), and 6 (revert rejected) remain valid as reasoning; its grounds 2-4 and every number cited from run-1 (123.4x, 5.14x geomean, 1.0843 cold, ~2.9 ms/invocation payback, ~72-invocation repayment) are VOID - they were derived from an invalidated baseline.
